    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    donuts = image_patch.find("donut")
    if not donuts: return image_patch
    tan_donuts = [d for d in donuts if d.verify_property("donut", "tan")]
    if not tan_donuts: return donuts[0]
    return tan_donuts[0]
